from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the legal document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) listed in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument] = Field(description="List of all legal documents parsed from the input")
